_comment: North has two trips: the head is stale (arrival_offset -300, departed 5 min
ago) and the second is a perfectly good upcoming trip (+300s -> '5 min').
IMPORTANT 2 (Task 5 review): fetch_trips used to only ever look at
upcoming[0], so a stale head trip would hide a perfectly good next train
and render 'no trains' instead of '5 min'. The fix scans the list for the
'assert_matches_stop' is gate.py's own convention (not part of the app):
when present, gate.py additionally renders THIS alternate stop payload
(north has only the good second trip, nothing else) and requires the two
renders to be pixel-identical -- proving the app actually selected and
used the second trip's data, not just that it avoided crashing or
happened to fall back to a 'no trains' placeholder that looks passable.
